name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Success
summary: Consumes one valid TOTP recovery code for the password-proved durable identity, invalidates the lost authenticator enrollment, disables TOTP until re-enrollment, and establishes a normal authenticated application session.

guards.expression: the MFA challenge is valid for the same durable identity, TOTP is enabled, and the submitted recovery code is valid and unused

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync consumes one recovery code, replaces the remaining-code blob, removes the current authenticator secret, sets TwoFactorEnabled false, and updates LastMfaDateTimeUtc when used as step-up.

The handler resolves the durable identity exclusively from the password-issued MFA challenge, invokes the real recovery-code manager as step-up, and consumes the MFA challenge only after successful recovery proof.
Successful recovery proof is adapted into either the normal browser application session or the standard mobile token session.
